package.description: Ditto is an extension to the Windows Clipboard. You copy something to the Clipboard and Ditto takes what you copied and stores it in a database to retrieve at a later time.

en-US.description: Ditto is an extension to the Windows Clipboard. You copy something to the Clipboard and Ditto takes what you copied and stores it in a database to retrieve at a later time.
en-US.longDescription: Ditto is an extension to the standard windows clipboard. It saves each item placed on the clipboard allowing you access to any of those items at a later time. Ditto allows you to save any type of information that can be put on the clipboard, text, images, html, custom formats.
en-US.name: Ditto

zh-CN.description: Ditto 是 Windows 剪贴板的扩展工具。当你将内容复制到剪贴板时，Ditto 会将复制的内容保存到数据库中，以便日后随时取用。
zh-CN.longDescription: Ditto 是对标准 Windows 剪贴板的扩展。它会保存剪贴板上的每一项内容，让您可以在稍后随时访问这些内容。Ditto 允许您保存任何可以放入剪贴板的信息类型，包括文本、图像、HTML 和自定义格式。
